method.archiveSource: each exact original50 T3 candidate fixed revision, read through Git object database
method.dependencyEdges: for every selected test/source package and the root importer, follow any dependency whose name resolves to an active workspace package; this intentionally over-approximates workspace linking for same-name semver/catalog specs
method.limitations: Static package/import analysis does not execute dynamic runtime loading or derive arbitrary computed import strings; complete root Git tree IDs bind all scanned candidate archives.
method.sourceImports: scan TS/TSX/MTS/CTS/JS/JSX/MJS/CJS/Vue files in reachable workspace package roots plus all selected source/test paths; detect package-name imports, literal infra/relay paths, relative paths resolved against Git-tree paths, and tsconfig aliases targeting infra/relay
method.workspaceMembership: parsed root pnpm-workspace.yaml package globs; nested .repos packages outside those configured globs are excluded from active workspace graph
method.workspaceFilterJustification: For each candidate revision, the relay workspace manifest is present and its exact alchemy spec is recorded; selected source/test workspace dependency closures contain no t3code-relay edge; static source scans contain no imports into infra/relay. Excluding t3code-relay therefore removes a package outside every selected candidate package closure. The root manifest/workspace was not edited.
